description: The reply of an adapter to one request, as one line on its standard output. It is an answer to whether a accepts every instance that is valid under b, which is true, false or null as the label of a case is, or it says why there is none. Each of the five has its own keys, and a key that does not apply is left out.

answer.description: a accepts every instance that is valid under b.

seconds.description: What the checker took for the task, as its adapter measured it: parsing each schema once, and the check.

answer.description: Some instance is valid under b and invalid under a.

seconds.description: What the checker took for the task, as its adapter measured it: parsing each schema once, and the check.

counterexample.description: An instance that is valid under b and invalid under a. The key is left out where there is none: null is an instance. The runner asks a validator whether it is one, and a no with a counterexample that is none counts as a wrong answer.

message.description: A text for a person: what the checker says about its no.

Unknown.description: The checker ran and declined to answer.

answer.description: The checker ran and declined to answer.

seconds.description: What the checker took for the task, as its adapter measured it: parsing each schema once, and the check.

reason.description: What kind of reason the checker had, in a word or two that are the same for every task declined for it, such as the keyword that it does not support. A report counts the declined tasks by it.

message.description: A text for a person: the reason in full.

Error.description: The checker failed, by an exception or by rejecting a schema.

failure.description: There is no answer, because the checker failed.

message.description: A text for a person: the error.

seconds.description: What the checker took for the task, as its adapter measured it: parsing each schema once, and the check.

Timeout.description: The checker stopped itself after the time that the request allows. An adapter that cannot stop a check need not reply: the runner then counts the timeout itself and starts the adapter again.

failure.description: There is no answer, because the time ran out.
